page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top with page number at top right; signature mark at foot left of the column; a digitiser's banner at the bottom and cropped stray text at the left edge (not transcribed). No marginal notes inside the text block.

main_text.p: Supremo hoc Judice, non sperent, nisi ferale Theta.
main_text.head: Paraphrasis.
main_text.p: Sint in foro Vanitatis, nugatoribus illis, quales merentur patroni: ubi Sors cæca cognoscit caussas, vitilitigant & altercantur inter se discordes Experientiarum rabulę, avida sibi litem addicit exspectatio, anceps eventus comperendinat, & tandem casu vel tempore detectus error pronunciat sententiam. Habeant in Superstitionis tribunali, qui suâ caussâ plurimum velint: ubi ex tripode jus dicit Auctoritas: ubi quod majoribus placuit, imo non placuit subinde, sed aliud agentibus excidit, decretum, lex & oraculum est: ubi laborant sub verborum involucris perplexa mysteria: ubi de mente unius aliquando Scriptoris, diffusæ

page.notes: The first line of the running head is the title as printed; the page number 37 is printed at top right. The word "caussas" and "caussâ" are as printed. The line "fusæ" is the catchword-like continuation at foot, transcribed as the last line of text. Header and footer digitiser banner omitted.
